title: Origin to Cup
subject: A vibrant red coffee bean with a subtle golden halo, symbolizing freshness and quality, appearing in each scene

shots.image_prompt: Sunrise over misty green mountain slopes, coffee plants heavy with red cherries, golden light washing the valley, distant village smoke rising.
shots.voiceover: From the highest slopes, where dawn breaks first.

shots.image_prompt: Close-up of weathered hands gently plucking ripe red coffee cherries, morning dew glistening, shallow focus on fingertips and fruit.
Glowing coffee beans tumbling in a brass roaster, amber embers beneath, warm smoke curling into the air.
shots.voiceover: Small-batch roasted for depth and soul.

shots.image_prompt: Slow-motion espresso pour, dark liquid spiraling into a white ceramic cup, rich crema forming.
shots.voiceover: Every drop, a promise of purity.

shots.image_prompt: Young professional smiling on a city sidewalk, holding a minimalist paper cup with a red bean logo, steam rising into cool morning air.
shots.voiceover: Your perfect cup, born from mountain light.
